field.speaker: explainer
field.text: 「这次是经阴道子宫全切，不像开腹手术那样先在肚子上开切口。我们会从阴道这一侧暴露宫颈，沿宫颈周围的层次逐步分离、处理支持结构和子宫血管，再经阴道把子宫取出，最后检查止血并关闭阴道残端。膀胱和直肠都靠得很近，整个过程中会仔细辨认和保护。至于你清醒时可能会有什么感觉，等麻醉方式选定后我们再确认。」

bowel.speaker: patient
bowel.text: 「天、天哪……真的要从那里切进去开刀呀？！明明我也知道什么叫经阴道手术，可轮到自己……坂口，完了，我连那里的解剖结构都要被你看得一清二楚了……别、别笑！我是在认真问啦！……还有，旁边不是膀胱和直肠吗？是不是也要把肠子推到一边去？」

bowel_answer.speaker: explainer
bowel_answer.text: 「不需要像开腹手术那样，先把肠管大范围移开来建立腹部术野。这次主要经阴道、沿宫颈周围的层次操作；仍然要注意深部与腹腔的关系，尤其要保护膀胱和直肠。具体到牵拉、压迫会感觉多少，要看你接下来选的麻醉方式。我们会在开始前再和你确认。」

bladder.speaker: patient
bladder.text: 「……所以不是先把肠子推上去，而是要从宫颈前面慢慢分开膀胱呀……这一步我以前也跟患者解释过，听起来明明很普通。可现在换别人告诉我，等会儿从那里放器械、要被牵引的是我自己的宫颈……怎么光是想想就这么害怕呀！」

manipulator.speaker: explainer
manipulator.text: 「经阴道入路主要会用器械夹持宫颈、向下牵引，必要时调整方向，让前后方的层次逐步显露出来；不是从下面把子宫直接向上托高。膀胱会沿正确的层次推离，直肠也需要保护。你平时熟悉这些步骤，但今天是你自己接受手术。有不明白或担心的地方，现在可以继续问。」

reaction_lines.explain_plan: “I've been the doctor explaining procedures, so I know the general routine. But today I'm the one on the table... Tell me where you start, what the crucial steps are, and what I might feel if I'm awake. Properly, please.”
reaction_lines.brief_plan: “Mm, I've got the procedure. Such a short explanation—worried I'll start quizzing you? Hehe... Just don't skip the checks that matter. I'll make a proper anesthesia choice when we get to that step.”
reaction_lines.last_reassure: “...I know you’ll carefully check every step of the procedure you’re actually doing today. Sakaguchi, don’t leave me alone with my imagination, okay?”
reaction_lines.choose_general: “General anesthesia, huh... So I close my eyes, and when I open them, it'll all be over? Shame I'll miss the whole thing... But I'll go with that this time. You'll have to tell me all about it when I wake up.”
reaction_lines.choose_epidural: “An epidural, then. So I'll still be awake to hear you all talking? Hehe, that sounds rather like my kind of thing. But if the block doesn't cover enough, tell me plainly what the plan is, okay?”
reaction_lines.choose_local: “Local anesthesia? Mm... At least I won't sleep through it. But that only numbs the area around the incision, right? Tell me what I might feel deeper in, before I get a nasty surprise.”
reaction_lines.choose_none: “...No anesthesia again? You really did choose the bold option, Sakaguchi. All right, we agreed, so I'll try... But let me make one thing clear: if I scream my head off, you're not allowed to complain!”
reaction_lines.induction_reassure: “Mm... I know. Just breathe slowly. Hey, Sakaguchi... when I wake up, you'd better be...”
reaction_lines.insist_without_anesthesia: “Stop asking whether I'm just trying to act tough! I know it hurts—last time wasn't a dream... Knowing that doesn't stop me from being scared when I'm actually waiting for you to cut.”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_none: “Ah, wait... I know I have to stay still! But I'm tense all over. Please hold me steady... And don't let Sakaguchi see how badly I'm shaking.”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_local: “O-okay, I'll cooperate. The local anesthetic helps, but I know exactly what's in your hands. How am I supposed to be completely relaxed?”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_epidural: “I know my legs aren’t responding properly because of the anesthesia... But understanding it doesn’t stop me from panicking when I need someone else to hold me in position. I’m usually the one telling patients, ‘I’ve got you.’ Today I’m the one hanging on to you...”
reaction_lines.contact_pause: “Hah... thank you. Let me catch my breath. That last bit was a lot more intense than I expected... All right, don't rush me. I'm listening.”
reaction_lines.contact_command: “I know—stay still, relax, breathe slowly... Easy for you to say. I'm trying, Dr. Sakaguchi!”
reaction_lines.contact_continue: “...Mm. Go on. I just needed to complain for a moment. I didn't say you had to stand here waiting until I ran out of things to say.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_narrate: “So that's where we are... Once you explain it, I can follow the procedure in my head. It's just... my body isn't nearly as calm as my brain.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_eye_contact: “I'm okay... Oh, don't look at me like that! When you watch me with those worried eyes, it makes me want to cry even more.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_silent: “...Sakaguchi? Why did everyone go quiet? I know you're concentrating... but lying here listening to instruments clink without hearing a word is making my skin crawl.”
reaction_lines.closure_reassure: “It's really almost over? Don't just say that to cheer me up... At this point, ‘just a few more stitches’ sounds beautiful enough to make me cry.”
reaction_lines.closure_coach: “Okay, I'll keep still... Hah, take your time. Look at me—I'm a doctor, and I still need someone to talk me through getting stitched up.”
reaction_lines.closure_silent: “...We're already at the suturing stage, and you still won't say a word to me? Hmph. Once I'm off this table, I'm making you tell me about the whole operation from the beginning.”
reaction_lines.incision_marking_awake: “...You’re marking it already? After all that preparation, we’re finally almost at the incision, and I don’t feel relieved at all... Sakaguchi, tell me just before you make the cut, okay?”
reaction_lines.incision_marking_none: “W-wait, that’s just a marking, right? A minute ago I was complaining the preparation was taking too long... Now that you’re about to cut, why does it suddenly feel too fast? Let me catch my breath... Please.”
reaction_lines.incise_epidural: “...Ah, you've already made the incision? I can feel that you're working on me, but it's nothing like what I'd been imagining... Hah. So it's really started.”
reaction_lines.incise_local: “Ah—! That still startled me! The local anesthetic is doing something, but knowing the blade has actually touched me is worlds apart from watching beside the table.”
reaction_lines.incise_none: “Aah—!! Ow, that hurts! W-wait... Hah... Y-you really made the cut! I know I agreed to this, but that was just... Ngh, Sakaguchi, please be gentle!”

“...When I watched nurses do skin prep, it always seemed to take no time at all. Today you’re checking one area after another. I know it’s necessary, but I’m embarrassed and getting irritated... How much longer?”
ward_skin_prep_unnecessary: “Hold on, that area isn't part of this surgical field, is it? If you're only extending it out of habit, could you spare me a little?”
“Hm? That part can be skipped too? Then I want to think about it. I'm here for surgery, not to sign up for the deluxe pre-op preparation package.”
ward_surgical_cap: “Please tuck all my hair in... Sigh. Once the cap is on, it really feels like I’m being sent off to the operating table. I was so confident when I agreed, so why is just looking at this cap making me nervous?”
“When I checked patients’ caps, I’d smile and say, ‘Don’t worry, it’ll be over soon’... Now it’s my turn, and all I want to ask is—when you say ‘soon,’ how long is that, exactly?”
operative_positioning_awake: “...Arm here, move my body a little more... I know, I know! You all usually call me Dr. Nanjou, but today you’re arranging me one by one, and I have to ask before I can even turn over... This is so humiliating.”
“D-don’t rush me! I am cooperating... But once I’m in position I can’t just move, and then I have to wait for you to finish. You have work to keep you busy; I’m counting every single minute!”
operative_positioning_none: “W-wait... Please don’t all crowd around at once! I know I need to cooperate especially carefully without anesthesia, but the more seriously you say ‘preparation,’ the more I panic... Give me a moment.”
“The straps too, huh... Mm, I know they're for safety. But once I'm settled like this, it really hits me—even if I wanted to shrink away, there's nowhere to go.”
urinary_catheterization_awake: “...So it’s my turn for this part, too. You’re all coworkers I see every day, and now I’m lying here needing this kind of help... Ah, don’t look at my face! I’m mortified!”
“Hah... I used to tell patients, with a perfectly straight face, ‘Just relax.’ If you say that to me one more time today, I really might get mad... I’m trying my best!”
urinary_catheterization_none: “H-hey, wait a second! I know what this step involves, but all this time I’ve been lying however you tell me to lie... And now I have to go through this part wide awake, too. I’m so embarrassed I can hardly face anyone!”
“Ah... wait... I really am trying to cooperate. But the more matter-of-fact you all are, the more I feel like a patient whose every move has been decided for her... Ugh, this is mortifying.”
skin_disinfection_awake: “Cold! ...Oh, it's the antiseptic. I know, I know. But hearing patients react from beside the table and jumping at the touch yourself are two completely different things.”

“...We’re not finished yet? I know skin disinfection can’t be rushed, but after all that preparation in the ward, it feels like I’ve been waiting here on the table forever... You’re all busy doing things, while I just stare at the surgical lights and scare myself half to death.”
skin_disinfection_none: “...It's only skin prep. Why is my heart pounding already? Sakaguchi, when you really make the cut, you're not allowed to laugh at me.”

“Wait for the antiseptic to dry, drape the field, do the checks... I know, none of it can be skipped. But lying here doing nothing, I’m actually starting to wish you’d hurry up and make the cut... Wait, what?! Last time it hurt terribly when you cut into me! Why am I even saying that?!”

contact_pain_incision_01.prompt: ...Ah, I felt that at the incision. Sakaguchi, we've really started, haven't we? I know the procedure, so why is my heart racing like this...?

responses.explain_contact: Mm, I'm listening. Slow breaths, just like you said, right? ...So today I'm the one being coached by the doctor.
responses.brief_contact: I know, we're following the plan... I'll stay still. It's just much more real than I imagined.
responses.continue_contact: ...All right, I'll cooperate. Just don't expect me to act like the Dr. Nanjou who can watch an operation without batting an eye.

contact_no_anesthesia_incision_01.prompt: Aah! W-wait, Sakaguchi! I knew the first incision would hurt, but why does it have to feel so horribly sharp and real...?!

responses.steady_unanesthetized_contact_01: Hah... I'm listening. Just go a little slower. I can't pretend to be brave right now; let me catch my breath...
responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_01: You make it sound so easy to endure... Ngh! I know we have to keep going, but don't complain about how loudly I scream!

contact_no_anesthesia_incision_02.prompt: N-no... Are you going deeper already?! I haven't even recovered from that last part!

responses.steady_unanesthetized_contact_02: Hah... Just a moment's pause helps. Once I've stopped shaking, tell me what comes next, okay?
responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_02: Aaah! Hey, Sakaguchi! It's easy for you to say 'keep going' when I'm the one lying here feeling every bit of it!

contact_no_anesthesia_incision_03.prompt: Sakaguchi... Ngh, I know I was the one who said no anesthesia, but it hurts so much now. Not even a little...?

responses.steady_unanesthetized_contact_03: ...No? All right, I understand... Then at least go slowly and tell me what you're about to do next, okay?
responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_03: Ngh... Not even a moment to recover...?! I know you have to finish, but it hurts so much I could cry!

contact_default_01.prompt: ...Huh? We've started already? You're all so practiced I almost missed it. Just because I'm a doctor too doesn't mean you can skip telling me.

responses.reassure_start: Mm, that's reassuring. I'm your patient today, so remember to keep me informed.
responses.brief_start: All right, got it... Sigh. Even though I’ve been through this before, hearing “we’ve started” while I’m on the table still makes me nervous.
responses.silent_start: ...All right, I'll be quiet. I'm very good at cooperating... Or at least I'll try.

contact_pain_incision_02.prompt: Ah... I can feel the incision so clearly now. Sakaguchi, you can hear me, right? I haven't got the energy to keep pretending I'm calm today.

responses.acknowledge_second_contact: Mm, hearing you answer helps. Can you keep talking to me? It doesn't have to be much. Just a word now and then.
responses.brief_second_contact: Okay, you're still there... Hah. Then I'll hang on a little longer.

contact_fear_incision_01.prompt: ...Have you really made the incision? Not being able to see your hands makes me imagine all kinds of things. Don't laugh, Sakaguchi. I'm never frightened when I'm the one operating.

responses.orient_fearful_contact: Oh, so that's as far as you've gone... I understand. Tell me when you're about to do the next step too, okay?
responses.steady_fearful_contact: Mm... I'm listening to your voice. Breathe in slowly... Okay, at least I know you haven't left me alone.
responses.dismiss_fearful_contact: ...All right, I won't ask again. But I am scared, and don't scold me if I end up crying out.

responses.explain_progress: Oh... so it's still a planned step. Thanks for explaining. Otherwise I'd have imagined every worst-case scenario by now.
responses.brief_progress: Mm, so we're still on track... I understand. Just don't all go silent on me like that next time.
responses.dismiss_progress: ...All right, I won't distract you. But I really am frightened. Please don't treat that as a pointless complaint.

progress_default_01.prompt: Sakaguchi, how far along are we? The harder I try to work it out like a doctor, the more I realize I have no sense of time down here.

responses.answer_progress: Oh, so that part's finished. Hah... Hearing an actual update suddenly gives me something to look forward to.
responses.brief_answer_progress: Okay, stay with the plan. I trust you... Just don't leave me staring at the surgical lights and guessing forever.

cardiac_progress_fear_01.prompt: ...Are you working on my heart already? The quieter everyone gets, the more nervous I feel—and I usually love a quiet OR.

responses.explain_cardiac_progress: Mm, still the planned stage... Good. Just say something now and then, please, so I don't have to interpret every sound myself.
responses.brief_cardiac_progress: ...Understood. I'll try not to distract anyone. Just don't all forget I'm here, okay?

responses.explain_fatigue_progress: Oh, so that's the stage... As long as nothing went wrong. Hah, I really don't want you skipping steps just to save time.
responses.brief_fatigue_progress: Still on plan... okay, I trust you. But once I'm off the table, you have to let me complain about how long I've been lying here.

cabg_signature_01.prompt: ...I just heard 'anastomosis.' Sakaguchi, you're really making a new route for blood to reach my heart... It still sounds unbelievable.

responses.brief_cabg_milestone: ...Understood. I trust you all... This is just far more frightening than I imagined.

responses.coach_strain: Okay... in, then breathe out slowly... I'm trying, but my body isn't nearly as obedient as my brain.
responses.push_through_strain: ...I know. I'll try not to move... But when I'm off this table, you're going to hear exactly how miserable that was!

responses.coach_abdominal_strain: Hah... breathe out slowly, right? Okay, I'll hold on... My abdomen really isn't listening to me.

responses.coach_second_traction: Mm... breathe out slowly, try not to tense up so much... I’m trying. Ugh, why can’t my body listen to me for once?

responses.ignore_exposure: ...You say not to mind? Hey, I'm not trying to make trouble for anyone! I'm genuinely embarrassed today.

field.speaker: explainer
field.text: “This is a vaginal hysterectomy. Unlike an open abdominal procedure, we won't begin with an incision in your abdomen. We'll expose the cervix through the vaginal approach, work through the tissue planes around it, address the supporting structures and uterine blood vessels, and remove the uterus vaginally. After that we'll check for bleeding and close the vaginal cuff. The bladder and rectum are close to the operative field, so we'll identify and protect them carefully throughout. Once you've chosen an anesthesia method, we'll go over what you might feel if you're awake.”

bowel.speaker: patient
bowel.text: “G-good heavens... you're really going to make the incision down there?! I know perfectly well what a vaginal procedure is, but now that it's *me*... Sakaguchi, oh no, you're going to see the anatomy down there in every little detail... D-don't laugh! I'm asking a serious question! ...And aren't the bladder and rectum right next to it? Will you have to push my intestines aside too?”

bowel_answer.speaker: explainer
bowel_answer.text: “We won't need to move the intestines extensively to establish an abdominal operative field the way we would in an open procedure. This operation is approached vaginally, following the tissue planes around the cervix. We'll still watch the deeper anatomy and its relation to the abdominal cavity, especially protecting the bladder and rectum. How much traction or pressure you might feel depends on the anesthesia you choose next. We'll confirm that with you before we begin.”

bladder.speaker: patient
bladder.text: “...So you won't push the intestines up first. You'll carefully separate the bladder from the front of my cervix... I've explained that step to patients myself, and it always sounded so routine. But now someone else is telling me that instruments will go in down there, and it'll be *my* cervix they're going to hold and pull... Why does just thinking about it frighten me so much?”

manipulator.speaker: explainer
manipulator.text: “With the vaginal approach, we mainly use instruments to grasp the cervix and apply downward traction, adjusting the direction as needed to expose the tissue planes in front and behind. We don't simply push the uterus upward from below. We'll separate the bladder along the correct plane and protect the rectum as well. You're familiar with these steps from your work, but today you're the patient. If anything is unclear or worries you, you can keep asking.”

invitation_lines: “`{procedure_name}`? All right. But I'll be on the table today, so I can't casually double-check your instrument list for you.”
“Oh, so you're finally the one asking me onto the operating table? Hehe, all right, I accept. Just so you know, the patient might not be the first one to blush today.”
“`{procedure_name}`? Of course. I wonder if Dr. Sakaguchi will still manage to explain everything with that perfectly serious face once I'm in a patient gown.”

surgery_hysterectomy: “`{procedure_name}`... I know that's not the same as removing a single fibroid. Explain the full scope, and I'll sign with a clear head. We can joke afterward.”
surgery_vaginal_hysterectomy: “`{procedure_name}`... I know that's not the same as removing a single fibroid. Explain the full scope, and I'll sign with a clear head. We can joke afterward.”
surgery_total_mastectomy: “I understand this means a complete removal, not just treating a lump. ...All right. I'm willing. Give me a little time to listen when we confirm the extent.”

reaction_lines.hospitalization_question: “I have to sign my own admission papers? Of course I do. It's just funny seeing my name in the ‘patient’ column.”
reaction_lines.hospitalization_response: “All right, I'm officially off nursing duty for now. ...What, you don't believe I'll stay put like a good patient? Hehe, you're not entirely wrong. But I'll cooperate today.”
reaction_lines.procedure_mismatch: “Hold on. That's not the operation we agreed on. Did you think I'd nod along like a brand-new nurse if you changed the name? ...Explain it. I'm listening.”
reaction_lines.explain_plan: “I could probably recite the routine. But please explain it properly today. When I used to give that explanation, I never had to imagine where I'd be lying afterward.”
reaction_lines.brief_plan: “‘We'll proceed as planned,’ huh... That sounds awfully familiar. Give me a couple of specifics, will you? Otherwise I'll start filling in the explanation for you.”
reaction_lines.last_reassure: “I've checked everything I needed to. Nothing to complain about. ...Hehe, don't look so relieved. I'm only taking a break from asking questions. Now I'm really putting myself in your hands.”
reaction_lines.choose_general: “General anesthesia? Fine. Once it takes effect, I won't even be able to say, ‘That chart entry is wrong.’ ...Please don't make me audit the nursing records when I wake up.”
reaction_lines.choose_epidural: “An epidural... Understood. I'll be awake, but my body won't move the way I want. ...Just imagining it is harder than it ever seemed from the nurse's side.”
reaction_lines.choose_local: “I know how local anesthesia works. If something feels wrong, I'll tell you. Don't expect me to keep smiling just to save face.”
reaction_lines.choose_none: “No anesthesia... I know what that means. I used to tell patients not to act tough, so I have no right to pretend I'm fearless. ...It's my decision, and I'll do my best to cooperate.”
reaction_lines.induction_reassure: “Dr. Sakaguchi, wait a second. ...No, it's all right. I never realized how distant ‘Relax, leave it to us’ sounds from this side of the pillow.”
reaction_lines.insist_without_anesthesia: “Don't ask me again whether I know what I chose. I do. ...But if I cry out, you don't get to laugh, or assume it means I've changed my mind.”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_none: “Ah...! I know I mustn't move! ...Please steady my shoulders. My mouth is good at giving orders, but my body isn't listening right now.”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_local: “Sorry, I tensed up on my own. The support is in the right place... Yes, just steady me. Thank you.”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_epidural: “My legs really aren't responding properly now. ...Don't laugh, I know that's expected. Would you check the support points for me?”
reaction_lines.incision_ready: “...Hey, y-you're really about to make the incision? I know the procedure, I do... Just wait a moment. Let me get one full breath in. Dr. Sakaguchi, look at me first...”
reaction_lines.incise_epidural: “...You've made the incision? Ah... It doesn't hurt the way I imagined, but I can feel that you've really started. ...I was going to make a joke just now.”
reaction_lines.incise_local: “Ngh...! That feeling deeper inside... Not a sharp pain, but it isn't pleasant. Keep going. I'll tell you exactly what I feel.”
reaction_lines.incise_none: “Ah—! It h-hurts...! I-I know the incision's been made... Don't make me look! ...Sorry, I'll try to hold still. Just let me cry out once...!”
reaction_lines.contact_pause: “...Phew. Thank you. I always tell patients they never need to apologize for being scared. But now that it's my turn, the words ‘I'm sorry’ come to my lips before I can help it... Let me catch my breath.”
reaction_lines.contact_command: “Understood. I won't move. ...You know, that tone actually works surprisingly well on me.”
reaction_lines.contact_continue: “All right, continue. ...Today I'm finally learning how much courage it takes to say those two words.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_narrate: “So that's where we are. Mm... Knowing the progress keeps my mind from wandering. Keep me informed, all right?”
reaction_lines.ongoing_eye_contact: “...There you are. I'm fine. ...Well, not exactly fine. But seeing how steady you are makes me a little less tempted to snap at everyone.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_silent: “...Why has it gone so quiet? I know you're busy, but can someone say something? I never noticed how hard it is to hear nothing but instruments.”
reaction_lines.closure_reassure: “We're really closing now? ...Then I won't scold you. I'll save my complaints until I can sit up properly.”
reaction_lines.closure_coach: “All right... In, out. I'll follow your pace. ...But Dr. Sakaguchi, how can your ‘just a little more’ last this long...?”
reaction_lines.closure_silent: “...Is it still not over...? I know you're doing the final checks... But I honestly... don't even have the strength left to complain... Dr. Sakaguchi, please, just a little sooner...”

ward_enema: “All right, I know about the enema. ...I was so confident teaching it to new nurses. Just don't call me ‘senior’ when it's my turn, okay?”
“Please close the curtain properly. ...Oh my, why the serious face? I'm just an ordinary patient right now. Hehe, don't look as though you're about to sit an exam.”
ward_enema_unnecessary: “This isn't required? Then explain the reason first. I may be off nursing duty, but my brain hasn't clocked out.”
“Good, as long as you've confirmed it's unnecessary. ...Oh, what a huge sigh of relief! Hehe, I wasn't even planning to quiz you.”
ward_skin_prep: “The skin-preparation area is confirmed? Good. ...What, does one glance from me make you nervous? Relax, today I'm just going to be a perfectly good patient... probably. Hehe.”
“The scissors sound awfully close from down here... Oh, don't look at me like that. I'm not testing your technique. Just take your time.”
ward_skin_prep_unnecessary: “That area isn't part of the surgical field, is it? If it's not necessary, let me keep a little dignity, please.”
“If we can skip it, tell me. ...I never knew hearing ‘we don't need to do that’ could be such a relief.”
ward_surgical_cap: “Is all my hair tucked away? Hehe, don't I look wonderfully well-behaved now? ...Don't be fooled. That cap hasn't tucked away my mischievous streak.”
“Don't leave a strand out for decoration. I do intend to come back to work... Ah, no, let's get through today first.”
operative_positioning_awake: “Oh my, today you're the one telling me where to put my arms and legs. Hehe, don't let your hands shake. I'll cooperate nicely... provided you ask sweetly enough.”
“A moment, my shoulder's a little tense... Mm, that's better. For once, I get to say, ‘This position is uncomfortable.’”
operative_positioning_none: “Positioning me without anesthesia... Understood. Make sure the supports are secure. I don't want my nerves to defeat me before the incision.”
“I know you're securing me carefully. ...But the less I'm allowed to move, the more I want to fidget. How annoying.”
urinary_catheterization_awake: “A catheter, then. Yes, I understand why it's needed. ...But give me a moment to prepare, and don't skip the explanation just because I know.”
“Gently, please. ...Oh, don't be nervous. I just couldn't help reminding you. Hehe, looks like it's my turn to be a slightly fussy patient today.”
urinary_catheterization_none: “I'm staying fully awake for this preparation too... It's all right, I know the procedure. ...Just let me grip the edge of the bed for a moment.”
“Even saying ‘proceed as usual’ feels difficult today. ...All right, I'll hold still. Go ahead.”
skin_disinfection_awake: “Ah, that's cold! ...Hehe, don't hold back that laugh. You don't often get to see me make a fool of myself. ...But it really is cold.”
“The antiseptic has to dry, I know. ...Honestly, those few minutes used to fly by on my side of the table.”
skin_disinfection_none: “That was only the antiseptic, and I nearly lost my composure. ...When the incision comes, I might be noisy. Sorry in advance.”
“It's cold... We haven't even begun, and my heart's racing. ...Dr. Sakaguchi, please don't make me guess when you're starting.”
incision_marking_awake: “Those marks look pretty accurate. ...Oh, don't make that face like I'm inspecting your work. I'm a good patient today. Hehe... But seriously, I'm counting on you.”
“Seeing the incision marks on myself from this angle feels unreal. ...Tell me when you're really about to begin.”
incision_marking_none: “W-wait! That's still the marker, right? I know... I know it is. But my eyes are already looking for the scalpel.”
“Finished marking? ...Is this where I make my last joke? ...Forget it. I suddenly can't think of one.”

contact_pain_incision_01.prompt: “Ngh...! That felt wrong for a moment... H-have you really started cutting? I can't believe this familiar step startled me.”

responses.explain_contact: “All right, you've started... I heard you. Breathe, yes, I'll do that.”
responses.brief_contact: “That's all you're giving me? ...Fine. Knowing it's going as planned is enough.”
responses.continue_contact: “I-I know. I won't move... Please don't throw my own old instructions back at me.”

contact_no_anesthesia_incision_01.prompt: “Ah...! That hurts... And I was actually thinking of grading your technique a moment ago...!”

responses.steady_unanesthetized_contact_01: “Okay... Slower... I'll breathe with you. Thank you for letting me relax my shoulders first.”
responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_01: “Ngh... I understand... I'll try to bear it. Just don't give me a lecture right now.”

contact_no_anesthesia_incision_02.prompt: “W-wait...! I can't see your hands. I can only feel what's happening... It's much scarier than I imagined!”

responses.steady_unanesthetized_contact_02: “...Yes, just a moment's pause. I can still cooperate. Give me one breath.”
responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_02: “Ah...! All right, I won't pull away... Keep going...!”

responses.continue_unanesthetized_contact_03: “I said no additional anesthesia... Ah, that hurts! ...Keep going. I'll do my best to stay still.”

contact_default_01.prompt: “Oh my, we've started? I was all ready to hear whether you'd sound nervous during the first step... Wait, why am I the nervous one?”

responses.reassure_start: “Mm, if things are stable, that helps. ...All right, it helps halfway.”
responses.brief_start: “Oh, that's all I get? Afraid I'll catch you sounding nervous if you say any more? ...Hehe, all right. I know we're on plan.”
responses.silent_start: “...All right, I'll be quiet. If you hear me humming, pretend you didn't.”

contact_pain_incision_02.prompt: “Ngh... There it is again. ...Strange. Even knowing this part was coming doesn't make feeling it any less frightening.”

responses.acknowledge_second_contact: “As long as you've confirmed it. ...I'll stop trying to predict your next move.”
responses.brief_second_contact: “...All right, continue. I'll bite my lip this time.”

contact_fear_incision_01.prompt: “Wait, what was that just now? I'm not trying to take over... I suddenly really need to know where we are.”

responses.orient_fearful_contact: “...Oh, we're past that part already. I thought we were only just starting.”
responses.steady_fearful_contact: “Keep talking. I'm listening. ...Yes, it's better when I can hear your voice.”
responses.dismiss_fearful_contact: “Oh my, that's stern. ...Usually I'm the one who uses that tone to take charge. All right, I'll stop asking... But I really am a little scared.”

responses.brief_progress: “...Still working on it. All right, I'll wait.”
responses.dismiss_progress: “You're telling me not to get distracted? ...I'd love to, but right now I can hear every little sound.”

responses.explain_cardiac_progress: “The critical steps are still on schedule, yes... Knowing you're watching the monitors helps a little.”
responses.brief_cardiac_progress: “...As long as it's on schedule. I won't pretend I'm not nervous anymore.”

cardiac_progress_default_01.prompt: “Should we be moving to the next stage about now? ...I know I can't see. Just give me a short answer.”

responses.answer_cardiac_progress: “Mm, I follow. Your explanations are clearer than I expected.”
responses.brief_cardiac_answer: “All right, I understand. I'll leave the rest to you.”

responses.explain_fatigue_progress: “I see... Knowing what's left is much better than just waiting. Thank you.”
responses.brief_fatigue_progress: “Still on schedule... All right. I'll try to hang in there.”

responses.mark_fatigue_milestone: “Oh, we've reached that point. ...All right, I'll make that my next little milestone.”
responses.encourage_fatigue_progress: “The important part's done? ...Then I'll believe your good news for now.”

thoracic_progress_fatigue_01.prompt: “This side of my chest... How far along are we? Every time I hear you change instruments, my heart jumps.”

responses.explain_thoracic_progress: “Mm, I understand this thoracic stage now. ...I'll stop watching the instruments and focus on listening to you.”
responses.brief_thoracic_progress: “The critical portion is still proceeding as planned. Good... I'll remember that.”

vascular_progress_deep_01.prompt: “You all sounded suddenly more focused just now. ...The vascular step is still under control, right?”

responses.explain_vascular_milestone: “So we've reached that crucial point. Mm... I trust you to keep a close watch on every change.”
responses.brief_vascular_milestone: “Within expectations. ...Good. That's all I needed to hear.”

cabg_signature_01.prompt: “...Are we at the reconstruction stage? I've read operative reports before, yet just thinking about this makes my heart race.”

responses.explain_cabg_milestone: “All right, we're at the planned reconstruction step... I understand. Thank you for still explaining it to me.”
responses.brief_cabg_milestone: “The planned critical step, yes. ...Then I won't press you for every detail.”

responses.explain_abdominal_strain: “Mm, you're working through this stage inside the abdomen. I understand... Let me steady my breathing.”
responses.coach_abdominal_strain: “In... out... Okay... I'll hang on a little longer.”

responses.coach_second_traction: “All right, breathe out slowly... I'll try not to tense up so much.”

strain_pain_pressure_01.prompt: “...That pressure hasn't let up. You haven't forgotten that I can still feel it, have you?”

responses.relieve_pressure: “Ah... That's better. Thank you for stopping to adjust it.”
responses.explain_pressure: “It'll last a little longer... Understood. Then please keep me updated.”

urologic_strain_pressure_01.prompt: “...Why is that dull feeling still there? I know this is delicate work, but it really is hard to endure.”

responses.pause_urologic_strain: “...Mm, that let me catch my breath again. Thank you.”
responses.explain_urologic_strain: “So it's the deep work at this stage... All right, I understand.”

dignity_low_exposure_01.prompt: “...Hey, even I think this is an embarrassing angle. Wait—could you cover the other areas a little better?”

responses.ignore_exposure: “Just don't think about it? ...I'll remember that one. Next time I'm teaching, it's going on the list of things not to say.”

responses.protect_dignity: “Mm, that's better covered. ...You're doing the right thing. You don't have to look so nervous around me.”
responses.brief_dignity: “This part will be over soon? ...Then I'll pretend I can't see any of you for a moment.”

pelvic_dignity_exposure_01.prompt: “...Of course I know this is how you position someone for pelvic surgery. I used to be the one adjusting the leg supports... Just please don't let too many people watch.”

responses.explain_pelvic_stage: “Mm, I understand this stage. Keep the unnecessary areas covered, and I'll feel a little better.”
responses.brief_pelvic_stage: “According to the preoperative plan... All right. I trust you.”

pelvic_dignity_default_01.prompt: “...Can I ask about the progress? ...No, don't laugh. I'm honestly afraid to imagine how far along you are.”

responses.answer_pelvic_progress: “Mm, still at the planned step. ...Good. That's enough of an answer.”

breast_dignity_exposure_01.prompt: “I knew this area would have to be exposed when I signed. ...But making eye contact with coworkers I know still feels... Oh, stop staring at me.”

responses.confirm_breast_scope: “Good, the scope matches what we discussed. I'll treat this as a very personal demonstration of patient privacy.”
responses.brief_breast_scope: “Within the agreed scope... Mm. I'll stop scaring myself with guesses.”

breast_dignity_default_01.prompt: “...Can I ask which stage you're at now? I had a witty remark ready, but I've forgotten every word.”

responses.answer_breast_stage: “Mm, just as you explained beforehand. ...Knowing that makes me feel much better.”
responses.brief_breast_stage: “Just follow the original plan. ...We can talk about everything else when you're finished.”

dignity_low_exposure_02.prompt: “...Did I already ask about the drapes? Sorry, but every time a sheet moves, I feel as if everyone is looking at me.”

responses.reduce_exposure_again: “Ah, thank you. That small adjustment is enough to put me at ease.”
responses.acknowledge_exposure_again: “You're right. I know what's necessary. ...Thank you for at least taking my complaint seriously.”

dignity_cooperation_exposure_01.prompt: “I'm not refusing to cooperate! ...I just want to know how many people actually need to be here.”

responses.limit_observers: “Mm, that makes me feel better. Thank you. You don't have to treat me like some impossible senior nurse.”
responses.brief_privacy_confirmation: “All right, everyone is here for a necessary reason... I understand.”

hysterectomy_signature_01.prompt: “...You're following the full hysterectomy plan I signed, right? I know I'm asking a lot, but I signed that consent form myself.”

responses.confirm_hysterectomy_scope: “Mm, every part of the scope has been confirmed. ...Thank you for taking the time to explain it item by item.”
responses.brief_hysterectomy_scope: “Nothing beyond the consented scope. Understood. ...I'll try not to imagine anything else.”

ovarian_cystectomy_signature_01.prompt: “...The plan to preserve the ovary hasn't changed, has it? You know, I'm the patient. It's reasonable for me to ask.”

responses.confirm_ovarian_preservation: “Mm, the goal is still to preserve healthy tissue. ...All right, I trust your judgment.”
responses.brief_ovarian_preservation: “Understood. ...I know you've kept that plan in mind.”

myomectomy_signature_01.prompt: “...I know this is a myomectomy, not a hysterectomy. The plan hasn't changed, right?”

responses.confirm_myomectomy_scope: “Good, the procedure hasn't changed. ...Mm, today I really needed to hear you confirm that yourself.”
responses.brief_myomectomy_scope: “As long as it's still the original plan. ...I won't interfere with your work.”

breast_tumor_signature_01.prompt: “Is the removal area still the one we marked beforehand? ...Don't call me fussy. Today I just need to hear you confirm it again.”

responses.confirm_breast_tumor_scope: “Mm, it matches the markings. Thank you. I feel better hearing that.”
responses.brief_breast_tumor_scope: “Still within the original boundaries... Good. I'll keep lying still, then.”

mastectomy_signature_01.prompt: “...I know I agreed to the complete removal. But being at this point still hurts emotionally. ...Please confirm that you remember the scope we agreed on.”

responses.acknowledge_mastectomy_loss: “...Thank you for not brushing it aside with a joke. I've heard the scope clearly. Please continue.”
responses.confirm_mastectomy_plan: “Mm, strictly within the consented scope. ...I trust you. Don't let me frighten myself with guesses.”

ongoing_fear_default_01.prompt: “...It's gone so quiet again. Dr. Sakaguchi, could you at least let me know nothing's gone wrong?”

responses.reassure_ongoing: “Mm, still on plan... Good. Hearing you say it helps.”

ongoing_default_01.prompt: “Am I being a good patient? Hehe, usually I'm the one telling people to hold still. Today you get to keep an eye on me. ...Honestly, lying here isn't easy either.”

responses.coach_ongoing: “I know. Just because I'm lying here so obediently doesn't mean I've forgotten how to follow instructions. ...Hehe, all right, I'll hold still.”
responses.reassure_ongoing_default: “I'm doing fine like this? ...Hehe, I can't believe I'm a little pleased to get praise from you today. All right, I'll stay still.”

ongoing_fear_fatigue_01.prompt: “...Feels like another long stretch has passed. When I was working beside the table, I'd forget the clock. Now I can't think of anything but time.”

responses.maintain_running_update: “That's better... Even one small update keeps my mind from running away with me.”
responses.brief_running_update: “Stable is good. ...I no longer expect a report every minute.”

ongoing_fear_fatigue_02.prompt: “This waiting is getting to me... Can you tell me at least what the next milestone is?”

responses.preview_next_milestone: “All right, I've heard the next goal. ...When we reach it, I'm awarding myself a point.”
responses.encourage_next_milestone: “Almost at the next stage? ...You really do know how to encourage someone. Today it's my turn to believe it.”

responses.adjust_pressure_points: “Thank you... That pressure point feels much better after the adjustment. Much appreciated, circulating nurse.”
responses.coach_position_stillness: “All right, I won't move on my own... I'll relax a little at a time. Mm, this works.”

abdominal_ongoing_pressure_01.prompt: “Hah... There's a constant heavy feeling deep in my abdomen. Dr. Sakaguchi, how much longer according to the plan? ...Don't leave me guessing from the instrument sounds alone.”

responses.explain_abdominal_pressure: “A critical stage, then... No wonder I can feel it so clearly. All right, I'll leave the team in charge for now and focus on breathing.”
responses.brief_abdominal_pressure: “That pressure is expected... Mm, good to know.”

pelvic_ongoing_position_01.prompt: “...Being positioned like this for so long is exhausting my lower back and legs. Could you check the supports again? I know I shouldn't shift by myself, but this position is so hard to bear...”

responses.support_pelvic_position: “Ah, you've adjusted the supports? That does feel a little better... Thank you.”
responses.coach_pelvic_position: “Mm, relax my lower back first, don't tense my legs... I'll follow your directions.”

thoracic_ongoing_position_01.prompt: “My shoulder and back feel so stiff... Not the incision, the position. ...I know I can't turn myself over, but I really want to.”

responses.check_thoracic_support: “Mm, my back feels much better. Good thing you asked when you did... I was about to grip a hole right through the sheet.”
responses.coach_thoracic_stillness: “All right, I'll relax only what I safely can. ...This isn't the time to make me prove how tough I am.”

cardiac_ongoing_fatigue_01.prompt: “...You're still working, aren't you? I can barely tell the instrument sounds apart anymore. I'm afraid I'll start imagining things.”

responses.reassure_cardiac_ongoing: “Mm, now I know where we are... I'll keep up and stop guessing.”
responses.brief_cardiac_ongoing: “Still proceeding as planned... Good. Thank you for saying so.”

vascular_ongoing_pressure_01.prompt: “...That pressure has come back. I know you're watching the monitors, but I can't stop myself from asking.”

responses.separate_vascular_sensations: “Oh, what I'm feeling isn't the same thing as the measurements you're watching... I understand. Thanks for explaining.”
responses.brief_vascular_pressure: “You're still monitoring everything closely... Mm, all right. I'll try to follow your lead.”

closure_default_01.prompt: “...Are you about to close? ...This patient of yours is out of energy for guessing instrument sounds.”

responses.confirm_closure: “The main steps are finished? ...Goodness, I've never heard anything so lovely.”
responses.brief_closure: “Final checks... Mm, I'll wait. ...Just don't wake me up for a quiz if I drift off.”

closure_fear_closure_01.prompt: “You said ‘closing,’ didn't you...? Don't tease me. I don't even have the energy to joke anymore.”

responses.confirm_closure_phase: “Mm, we're really in the closure phase. ...Good... Hah... I'll wait a bit longer.”
responses.brief_closure_phase: “The final work... All right. All I want to hear now is ‘finished.’”

closure_fear_closure_02.prompt: “...Why are there more checks...? I know they're important, but I'm almost at my limit.”

responses.explain_final_checks: “Checking each item... All right, I understand. Could you tell me whenever one is finished? ...I'm really running out of strength.”
responses.confirm_final_checks: “You're closing... Mm. Please, let this really be the end soon.”

closure_pain_closure_01.prompt: “Ngh... Why does this last part hurt again...? I really don't want to move when we're so close to finishing...!”

responses.pause_closure_discomfort: “Ah... A little better. Thank you for not rushing me just because we're nearly done.”
responses.pace_closure_breathing: “All right... I'll follow... In, out... Mm, continue.”

breast_closure_fear_01.prompt: “...Is the work on my breast finished now? I'm afraid I'm asking too soon... But I really want to know.”

responses.answer_breast_closure: “Mm, the completed work matches the scope we discussed... Good. That puts me at ease.”
responses.brief_breast_closure: “Closing as planned... I'll wait to hear you say that final word.”

stage_prompts.graphic_preop_question: “Please go through the details once more. I'm used to checking the plan and supporting the operation from the clinical team's side. Today I'm listening from the table instead. ...I'd like to hear every step from the patient's point of view.”
